test_nested_modules: test that pybind11 nested modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test that pybind11 classes with internal references manage object lifetimes and copy assignments correctly
test_importing: test that a pybind11 module can re-export a Python builtin like OrderedDict
test_pydoc: test that pydoc can generate documentation for a pybind11 module and its contents
test_def_submodule_failures: test that defining a pybind11 submodule with malformed UTF-8 names raises appropriate errors
